title: A session resumed after a compaction runs session_start.sh, so it learns its hooks lag main
why: Coordinator 17:17 CST Nov 9: settings.json runs hooks/session_start.sh only on the SessionStart matcher `startup|resume`. A compaction resume does not match, so #2473's hooks-lag line never prints on the path where today's stale-hook incident happened (lanes with hooks older than #1521 could not do mixed merges).
note: Waits on the owner: page item 466 (compact-resume-matcher). Change: matcher `startup|resume` becomes `startup|resume|compact`. Cost: one extra hook run per compaction, 2 git reads and 1 bounded fetch. A settings.json edit needs the owner's word; a lane builds it and proves the pick with page_grant.py. Related: live-hooks-lag-named (#2473). Owner picked 466 a (19:22 CST Nov 9): add `compact` to the matcher. Item 466 stays open until that lane proves the pick with page_grant.py. Lane session_013NEJL1E4aAkTZ2bok4QsVD started 19:23 CST Nov 9; it proves 466 a with page_grant.py (coordinator). PR #2481 released into batch-70c (review record 6756910035; coordinator 20:08 CST Nov 9). Done when batch-70c merges; item 466 closes then.
